[P2] Include observed fault releases in the retirement boundary

Setting `faultsCreated[0].releasedAtMs` to `230` in `deadline_evidence()` passes final validation even though `retirement.retiredAtMs` is `220` and the retirement release timestamp is `210`. This check bounds only the retirement record; the separately observed release is checked for numeric validity and ordering against cleanup. Consequently, the CLI can report `PASSED` while retained evidence places fault release after retirement. Include supplied observed release timestamps in the retirement boundary check, reject contradictory release records for the same fault, and add a regression for this case.
